svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print top face down on a smooth bed: 30 x 40 x 1.5, corners R3.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four screw holes 2.2 mm at the horn positions (13 and 17.4 each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side of centre), each with a 90 degree countersink 3.8 across.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Light pipe bore: drill 2.0 mm on the centre line, 6.5 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre toward one strap end, over the module's status LED.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the LED position on the module you buy and move it to suit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Light pipe: cut 2 mm off the rod, square and polish both ends,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: press in flush with the top, a drop of clear epoxy underneath.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It stands 0.5 mm below the lid, 1.2 mm above the module.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lies on the gasket; four M2 x 6 countersunk screws into the horns.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the screw heads sit flush or just below the top face.
